units: <cite ref="Berakhot 40a">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 40b">40ᵇ</cite> <he>איתיה לג׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. F. <he>גִּזְעָא</he>, Ar. <cite ref="C00516"><he>גִּזָּא</he></cite>) there remains a stem which produces fruits again.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b:4">Ab. Zar. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>קטפא דגַוָּזָא</he> ed. (Ms. M. <cite ref="C00328"><he>גווזא</he></cite>, Ar. <he>גזא</he>, <cite ref="C01123"><he>גנזא</he></cite>, v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. <he>גז</he> II, p. 262) ; <cite ref="Niddah 8b:15">Nidd. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>קטפא דגווזא</he> the gum which oozes out of the stem, opp. <he>דפירי</he>.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:7">Ned. 50ᵃ</cite> (became rich) <he>מן גַּוָּזָא</he> through a (hollowed out) trunk.
<cite ref="Nedarim 50a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>לא אשכחו אלא גווזא וכ׳</he> they found on the sea shore nothing (of the wrecked ship) except a trunk.

Ib. וכולי עיסקא מחית בההוא גוזא (Ar. גיאזא, read גו׳) and the entire treasure of the ship was hidden in that trunk; [Rashi: chest, v. גּוּזָּא].—2) [that which is cut off,] branches; [that which is chopped,] wood.
<cite ref="Chullin 8b:2">Ḥull. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>פסק ביה ג׳ לע״ז</he> (Ar. <cite ref="C00265"><he>גואזא</he></cite>) he cut wood with it for idolatrous purposes.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 22b:9">B. Kam. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ סילתא וכ׳</he> (Ms. O. a. Ar. <cite ref="C00265"><he>גואזא</he></cite>) chopped wood, kindling chips and light.
Sabb. 154ᵇ גואזא פרסכנא ed. (Ms. M. גווזא ופ׳, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) low and spreading ramifications (forming the fourth wall of a Succah).
Sabb. 155ᵃ let him rest the ladder אגוו׳ וכ׳ Ms. M. (ed. אגַּוָּואזֵי, Ms. O. גואזא) on the branches spreading beyond the circumference of the tree (Rashi: on pegs reaching beyond &c.).
Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי (חד מאת׳ 1) נעביד ג׳ let us divide by lots (comment.: pieces of wood on which names are written for raffling).
